title: Quadrant Orbit — Next-Quarter Hosted API & Model Catalog Sprint Planning
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Purpose: produce a prioritized, execution-ready quarterly plan that aligns hosted API feature launches with the model catalog rotations and capacity hedges. Goals: 1) Define a safe, measurable rotation plan for three model classes (conversational, instruction-tuned, embeddings) that preserves SLAs and reduces unit cost by 12% via quantization + batching experiments; 2) Create an end-to-end canary/runbook for model swaps in hosted endpoints that includes automatic fallback variants and cost-sla thresholds; 3) Identify cross-team dependencies (runtime, infra, evaluation, support) and commit owners for each milestone. Scope: roadmap artifacts for the quarter, dependency map, rollout schedule, canary gating criteria, staffing commitments, and a simple OKR mapping to the product team's quarterly objectives.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated roadmap with milestone dates and owners published in Confluence (owner: PM)
Dependency map validated with ENG and Design (no unassigned high-risk dependencies)
Canary runbook with explicit rollback triggers and playbook links exists and is tested in staging
Cost/latency targets set per model tier (p95 latency < 180ms for conversational; embeddings cost-per-embed <= target)
Evaluation harness and regression test set for each model rotation; baseline metrics captured
decisions: Prioritize rotations for instruction-tuned models first due to high customer impact for summarization use cases
Delay on-prem packaged telemetry integration to Q4 to avoid blocking cloud-hosted catalog cadence
Adopt a two-wave canary: internal beta (10% traffic, latency/QA gates) then progressive ramp (25%, 50%, 100%) with auto-fallback at each step
